The '''Naboo Betterment Society''' was an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

At some point during [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], local celebrity [[Kaydine]] was the Chancellor-elect of the organization.
